content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells|selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-workers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-3|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing e-commerce platform?

To integrate NOWPayments with your existing e-commerce platform, you'll need to follow these steps: set up a NOWPayments account, generate a payment button, and paste it into your platform's code. You can find detailed instructions in the NOWPayments documentation.
Can I use USDT for payment processing in countries with strict cryptocurrency regulations?

Yes, USDT is a stablecoin that can be used for payment processing in countries with strict cryptocurrency regulations. Its stability and regulatory compliance make it an attractive option for creators who want to avoid regulatory risks.
How do I handle refunds and chargebacks with a USDT payment gateway?
